observations: Predicted zero forbidden triangles in camps ABC,DE,F, where only a two-friendly/one-hostile triangle is forbidden.
Checked all20 in three camps: zero forbidden and six all-enemy triangles. Six singleton camps gave zero/20; two camps gave zero/zero.
Returned to three camps and made B–D friends: three forbidden triangles appeared, including A,B,D, and all-enemy count fell to five.
Reveal accurately distinguished original three-camp counts from the changed B–D graph and explained the weaker rule versus also forbidding all-enemy triangles.
